messages:
Etta Morales: hi everyone! thrilled to be joining Redwood as a Product Designer. :wave: i'll be in the SF office starting next Tue. quick intro: board game nerd, baker of mediocre cookies, and big tea fan. planning to bring some fresh biscotti + chocolate chip cookies at 10:30 — any allergies or strong preferences? :cookie: :tea:
Priya Sengupta: welcome Etta!! :tada: heads up, peanut allergy on my side. otherwise totally down for cookies and games. Catan group meets Thursdays if you want to join.
Luca Rivera: welcome!! Catan champion (humble brag). also we have a plant rota 94 want a tiny succulent for your desk? theyre low-maintenance.
Etta Morales: thanks! i'll avoid peanuts for sure. i'd love a succulent if there's one spare. and count me in for Catan 94 sheep trades are my specialty.
Becky (People Ops): welcome @Etta Morales 496 onboarding buddy = @Priya Sengupta. added "cookies at 10:30" to the office calendar for Tue. noted: no peanuts. quick poll: react :one: for biscotti, :two: for chocolate chip, :three: for both.
Luca Rivera: :three: (both please)
Priya Sengupta: :one: but will happily accept extras :P
Luca Rivera: i will swap a weekend plant watering shift for a biscotti. fair trade?
Etta Morales: perfect deal 94 i'll DM to coordinate watering schedule. thanks for the warm welcome, can't wait to meet you all in person! :smile:
welcome-bot: Welcome @Etta Morales to #new-hires! Onboarding checklist assigned. Please complete security training within 7 days. :sparkles:
